title: Three Weeks and One Short Basket
subtitle: 经济消费 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 经济消费（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）
meta: 主题语境：经济消费（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）　|　核心词汇：silver　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 silver 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1969 the trader ① polished the silver that no partner in the market would have described, and he said the polishing was the whole of the week. The ② silver, meaning the metal itself and not the basket, ran three weeks and stayed undescribed in the book; silver, he said, is the only thing in a market that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ sort of silver in that market had the same short basket beside it, and the ④ silver at the far stall, meaning the sample they kept for the children to show and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Silver, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the trader said the describing is the part that fills three weeks.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the silver was the whole of the matter, meaning the value and not the metal. The ⑥ silver, meaning the value and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; silver, he said, is either something you polish or the only word that means both metal and a value. He said the value is the part they remember.

By 1974 the ⑦ silver had become a line in a list, and the list had become an argument about the short basket. The ⑧ silver of the whole thing, the trader wrote in October, was one market and three weeks of describing; silver, he said, is either the sample at the far stall or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ silver I remember is the silver described in the list, which closed in 1976 and is still described as the quietest in the market. ⑩ Silver, my mother said in 1978, is the only thing that improves by being described; all silver, she said, is a value that has agreed to look like metal. She said the value was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 银；银色（指集市里每一种旁边的那一种）
B. n. 银；银色（指那块银本身，与小小的货篮相对）
C. 固定搭配：polish the silver 擦这一块银
D. n. 银；银色（指留给孩子们给人看的那一份）
E. n. 银之事（抽象总称，指一处集市的银之事）
F. n. 银；银色（指货单里写到、被描述的那一块）
G. n. 银、价值（指一件事里人人都卖却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 价值（抽象总称，指人人都卖却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: polished the silver that no partner in the market would have described
The silver, meaning the metal itself and not the basket
Every sort of silver in that market
the silver at the far stall
the silver was the whole of the matter
the silver had become a line in a list
The silver of the whole thing

answers.why: polish the silver 意为“擦这一块银”，1969 年那位货商把集市里没有一位伙计肯描述的一块银做了一遍。
silver 意为“银；银色”，指那块银本身而不是小小的货篮，它经过了三个星期而在簿子上没有被描述。
silver 意为“银；银色”，指集市里每一种旁边的那一种，每一种旁边都有同一只小小的货篮。
silver 意为“银；银色”，指最远那个摊子的留给孩子们给人看的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
silver 意为“银、价值”，指一件事里人人都卖却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这块价值就是那件事的全部。
silver 意为“价值”，指人人都卖却无人提起的那样东西而不是那块银，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
silver 意为“银；银色”，指货单里写到、被描述的那一块，到 1974 年这一块成了货单里的一行。
silver 意为“银之事”，货商十月写道，整件事的银之事是一处集市和三个星期的描述。
silver 意为“银；银色”，我记得的是货单里描述过的那一块，1976 年批完了，至今仍被说成集市里最安静的一块。
silver 为抽象总称，母亲 1978 年说，银是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的银。
